items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I kept Bill Chase with me... Chase was there every night, through the whole --

ctx.x: Why don't we go on to following the close of the decade of the '50s. Things start to happen again in the '60s for you.
Well, it was a very strange beginning,

because I once again was running out of gas. And I took a small group on the road. But I managed to hang out to what -- my key personnel in this small group, as far -- and it was a strange kind of small-group thing because it was like an act. But I kept the players that I felt I needed at the time, and that was Nat in the rhythm section, and the same rhythm section we had had in the band a little earlier. And I kept Bill Chase with me and I kept a tenor player, Gordon -- [Pierce]
